record.oneLiner: The Threads API by Meta provides REST endpoints for managing posts and profiles using OAuth 2.0 authentication, subject to App Review.
record.verdictReason: While the API is publicly documented and accessible for development, Meta enforces an App Review process before an application can be used to access production user data.

evidence.quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
Click the chevron next to each requirement listed under Prepare and submit for App Review. You must complete each requirement before publishing your app.
